command.description: Command that starts a server (e.g. 'npm start', 'dotnet run --launch-profile http').

cwd.description: Working dir for the command, relative to the project folder (e.g. ../../app-source/Frontend).

readyUrl.description: URL polled until it responds, so recording waits for this server to be up (defaults to the environment baseUrl).

businessPurpose.description: What the product is for, in end-user language. Feeds project-level video narration.

credentialsEnv.description: Env var NAMES only — values live in .env, never in yaml.

postLoginAssert.description: locator hint proving login landed, e.g. 'heading:Metrics'

channel.description: Browser channel (e.g. 'chrome') when bundled Chromium can't run.

ignoreHTTPSErrors.description: Accept self-signed/invalid TLS certs (common for a local https backend, e.g. https://localhost:5001). Valid certs pass regardless; set false to enforce cert validation.

voice.description: TTS voice/engine preset for this project's narration.

start.description: Command(s) that start the app locally; omit if already running/deployed. A single command, or a list (e.g. backend + frontend) started together.

defaultEnv.description: Which entry of `environments` to use when none is passed (WT_ENV / --env). Change this to switch the default recording environment.

environments.description: Named recording targets, e.g. live (deployed) and local (auto-started). Selected per run with --env <name> (or WT_ENV), else `defaultEnv`. Each overrides baseUrl and start.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for this environment (e.g. https://app… or http://localhost:5173).

start.description: Command(s) to auto-start for this environment before recording. A single command or a list (backend + frontend) started together.

credentialsEnv.description: Env var NAMES (values live in .env) for THIS environment's login, e.g. [WALKTHROUGH_LOCAL_EMAIL, WALKTHROUGH_LOCAL_PASSWORD] for a locally-seeded DB account. Overrides the project-level auth.credentialsEnv when this environment is selected. Omit to reuse the project-level credentials (the common case for a live/deployed target).

source.description: Where the app's source lives (relative to repo root), read by /walkthrough-discover. Either a list of paths, e.g. [app-source/Frontend, app-source/Backend], or a role->path map, e.g. { frontend: app-source/Frontend, backend: app-source/Backend }.

publish.description: Where finished narrated MP4s are copied by publish.mjs. Media is gitignored — this is its durable home. The WT_PUBLISH_DIR env var overrides dest.

dest.description: Directory (local path or mounted share) that receives <project>/<module>/<feature>.mp4 plus a manifest.json.
